interpretations: For each moon phase, count all matched telescopes, even those with missing bandwidth usage; calculate each phase’s average from nonmissing usage values, retain phases above the unweighted mean of phase averages, and return the unrounded average of retained phase averages, sum of their telescope counts, and average of their excesses over that mean

For each moon phase, count only matched telescopes with nonmissing bandwidth usage; calculate each phase’s average, retain phases above the unweighted mean of phase averages, and return the unrounded average of retained phase averages, sum of their counts, and average of their excesses over that mean
queries:
WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_average
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(phase_average) AS mean_average
  FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.phase_average) AS average_of_phase_averages,
  SUM(p.telescope_count) AS telescope_count,
  AVG(p.phase_average - m.mean_average) AS average_excess
FROM phase_stats AS p
CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
WHERE p.phase_average > m.mean_average

WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_average
  FROM observatories AS o
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE o.lunarstage IS NOT NULL
    AND t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(phase_average) AS mean_average
  FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT AVG(p.phase_average),
       SUM(p.telescope_count),
       AVG(p.phase_average - m.mean_average)
FROM phase_stats AS p
CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
WHERE p.phase_average > m.mean_average
